verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a multi-item action is the MCP server's ability to 'broadcast the same message to multiple team members' (quo-docs-11), which is a narrow bulk send rather than general bulk operations. The API is documented only as per-request with a 10 requests/second per-key rate limit (quo-docs-6), and there is no evidence of batch endpoints. Missing for 10: bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk contact create/update/delete, bulk operations beyond messaging team members, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
